tips.drop: Look where you want to land
tips.detonate: Right-click: pop every rivet you have stuck
tips.reel: Right-click: harpoon a wall and reel yourself to it
tips.health: Red cross: walk over it for + health on that part
tips.supplyDrop: Yellow beam: top loot lands there. Not under it
tips.titan: Junk Titan: hit the core. It chases whoever hit it last
